message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) in European populations**

| Source | Population | Allele frequency (ε2) |
|--------|------------|-----------------------|
| gnomAD v2.1.1 (non‑Finnish European, NFE) | 12,632 individuals | **≈ 0.07** (7 %) |
| 1000 Genomes Project (EUR superpopulation) | 503 individuals | **≈ 0.07–0.08** (7–8 %) |
| ExAC (European non‑Finnish) | 33,370 individuals | **≈ 0.07** (7 %) |

**Key points**

* rs7412 is one of the two SNPs that define the APOE ε2 allele (the other being rs429358).  
* The ε2 allele is the least common of the three major APOE alleles (ε2, ε3, ε4) in Europeans, with ε3 being the most frequent (~ 0.75) and ε4 ~ 0.15.  
* Frequencies can vary slightly among sub‑European groups (e.g., higher in Southern Europeans, lower in Northern Europeans), but the overall range remains ~ 5–10 %.  

**References**

1. gnomAD Browser – https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412  
2. 1000 Genomes Project – https://www.internationalgenome.org/data-portal/variant/rs7412  
3. ExAC Browser – https://exac.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412  

These databases provide allele counts and frequencies for rs7412 across many populations, allowing you to retrieve the most up‑to‑date numbers if needed.
